0022600033.text: The San Antonio Spurs (6-2) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-7) in the Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup, the Spurs' ninth game of the season. San Antonio is second in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and riding a six-game winning streak, while Sacramento is fifth in the Pacific, 5.5 games back, and has lost its last game. Out for the Spurs are Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and out for the Kings are Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). San Antonio leads the 2026-27 series 1-0 after a 130-103 win in San Antonio on October 27, and the Spurs won all three meetings in 2025-26.
